title: Pick List

purpose.en: The list a warehouse officer follows to take material for one Work Order. It is made from the confirmed material booking: the system chooses pallets, batches and bins, and Confirm Pick issues the stock to the work order.
purpose.id: Daftar yang diikuti petugas gudang untuk mengambil bahan satu Work Order. Dibuat dari booking bahan yang sudah Confirm: sistem memilih palet, batch, dan bin, lalu Confirm Pick mengeluarkan stok ke work order.

keywords: pick list, picking, ambil bahan, daftar ambil, pengambilan bahan, work order, wo, palet, pallet, batch, bin, scan, fifo, fefo, stock out, keluar gudang, alokasi, short, kurang

steps.en: Click + New Record, choose the Work Order and click Create. Only work orders with a confirmed material booking and no open pick list are offered.
steps.id: Klik + New Record, pilih Work Order lalu klik Create. Hanya work order yang bookingnya sudah Confirm dan belum punya pick list terbuka yang ditawarkan.

steps.en: Read each material card: need, allocated quantity and the pallets, batches and bins to take. Paper follows FIFO, ink and glue follow FEFO, as set per storage area.
steps.id: Baca tiap kartu bahan: kebutuhan, qty teralokasi, serta palet, batch, dan bin yang diambil. Kertas mengikuti FIFO, tinta dan lem FEFO, sesuai pengaturan area.

steps.en: A line marked Short means no allowed stock is left. Reallocate when stock arrives, or cancel the pick list. Confirm Pick is refused while any line is short.
steps.id: Baris bertanda Short berarti tidak ada stok yang boleh dipakai. Klik Reallocate saat stok datang, atau batalkan pick list. Confirm Pick ditolak selama ada baris short.

steps.en: Go to the bin. In Scan type or scan the pallet label, then the bin label, and click Scan. The line becomes Scanned. A wrong pallet or bin is refused.
steps.id: Datangi bin. Di Scan ketik atau pindai label palet, lalu label bin, dan klik Scan. Baris menjadi Scanned. Palet atau bin yang salah ditolak.

steps.en: When every line is scanned, click Confirm Pick. A Stock Out to the work order is posted, pallets are reduced and need a new label, and the booking is marked issued.
steps.id: Bila semua baris sudah dipindai, klik Confirm Pick. Stock Out ke work order diposting, palet dikurangi dan perlu label baru, dan booking ditandai sudah keluar.

steps.en: Cancel releases the allocation and needs a reason. Print gives the pick list for the floor.
steps.id: Cancel melepas alokasi dan butuh alasan. Print menghasilkan pick list untuk dibawa ke lantai gudang.

fields.label: Work Order
fields.en: The work order to take material for. Picked when the pick list is created.
fields.id: Work order yang bahannya diambil. Dipilih saat pick list dibuat.

fields.label: Deliver To
fields.en: Production staging bin where the material is taken. Left empty, the first staging bin is used.
fields.id: Bin staging produksi tempat bahan diantar. Bila kosong, dipakai bin staging pertama.

fields.label: Pick List
fields.en: Number given by the system when the pick list is created.
fields.id: Nomor yang diberikan sistem saat pick list dibuat.

fields.label: Booking
fields.en: The confirmed material booking and Customer Order the pick list comes from. Filled by the system.
fields.id: Booking bahan yang sudah Confirm dan Customer Order asal pick list. Diisi sistem.

fields.label: Need Date
fields.en: The earliest date any material line is needed. Filled from the booking.
fields.id: Tanggal paling awal bahan dibutuhkan. Diisi dari booking.

fields.label: Scanned Code
fields.en: The code read from a pallet label or a bin label. The system decides whether it is the pallet or the bin of an open line.
fields.id: Kode hasil baca label palet atau label bin. Sistem menentukan apakah itu palet atau bin dari baris yang masih terbuka.

fields.label: Pallet
fields.en: The pallet to take from. It carries the batch and the received date.
fields.id: Palet yang diambil. Membawa batch dan tanggal datang.

fields.label: Quality
fields.en: Status of the batch. Only Released and, for ordinary jobs, Conditional batches are allocated. Quarantine, Rejected and Blocked never are.
fields.id: Status batch. Hanya batch Released dan, untuk job biasa, Conditional yang dialokasikan. Quarantine, Rejected, dan Blocked tidak pernah.

title: Pre-Booking

purpose.en: Shows the paper needed for jobs whose Pro-Cost is published but that have no Customer Order yet, so Planning and Purchasing can act early. A pre-booking is soft; Hold keeps the stock for a few working days.
purpose.id: Menampilkan kertas yang dibutuhkan job yang Pro-Cost-nya sudah terbit tetapi belum punya Customer Order, supaya Planning dan Pembelian bisa bergerak lebih awal. Pre-booking bersifat lunak; Hold menahan stok beberapa hari kerja.

keywords: pre booking, prebooking, booking awal, booking dini, belum co, not co yet, procost terbit, hold, tahan stok, kertas, kebutuhan bahan, quotation, short run, pick item

steps.en: Open Pre-Booking. Each row is an inquiry whose Pro-Cost is published. Click Recalculate All to refresh them; the nightly planning run does the same.
steps.id: Buka Pre-Booking. Tiap baris adalah inquiry yang Pro-Cost-nya sudah terbit. Klik Recalculate All untuk memperbarui; perhitungan malam melakukan hal yang sama.

steps.en: Read the Stage: Not CO yet, Quotation (a quotation is issued), or Customer Order (draft). When the Customer Order is Confirmed, the same booking continues as its booking.
steps.id: Baca Stage: Not CO yet, Quotation (quotation sudah terbit), atau Customer Order (draft). Saat Customer Order Confirmed, booking yang sama berlanjut sebagai bookingnya.

steps.en: Double-click a row. Lines marked Need item only have the paper size and weight from the costing, so use Pick Item to choose the stock item.
steps.id: Klik dua kali sebuah baris. Baris Need item baru punya ukuran dan gramatur kertas dari costing, jadi pakai Pick Item untuk memilih item stok.

steps.en: A pre-booking does not reduce the available stock. A shortage that only comes from pre-bookings is marked Not CO yet in Material Planning.
steps.id: Pre-booking tidak mengurangi stok yang tersedia. Kekurangan yang hanya berasal dari pre-booking diberi tanda Not CO yet di Material Planning.

steps.en: Use Hold, with a reason, to keep the stock for a critical material. The hold ends by itself after the working days set in Constants. Release Hold ends it earlier.
steps.id: Pakai Hold, dengan alasan, untuk menahan stok bahan kritis. Hold berakhir sendiri setelah hari kerja yang diatur di Constants. Release Hold mengakhirinya lebih awal.

steps.en: A pre-booking ends by itself when the quotation expires, the Pro-Cost is reversed or the inquiry is cancelled.
steps.id: Pre-booking berakhir sendiri bila quotation kedaluwarsa, Pro-Cost dibalik, atau inquiry dibatalkan.

fields.label: Inquiry / Customer
fields.en: Inquiry number and customer of the job. Filled from the inquiry.
fields.id: Nomor inquiry dan customer job. Diisi dari inquiry.

fields.label: Stage
fields.en: Where the job is on the booking ladder: Not CO yet, Quotation or Customer Order (draft). Set by the system.
fields.id: Posisi job pada tangga booking: Not CO yet, Quotation, atau Customer Order (draft). Diatur sistem.

fields.label: Material Needed By
fields.en: The inquiry due date, or the working days from today set in Constants when there is none.
fields.id: Due date inquiry, atau hari kerja dari hari ini yang diatur di Constants bila belum ada.

fields.label: Coverage
fields.en: Whether stock, PO or PR covers the need: Covered by stock, Waiting PO/PR, Late, Short or Need item.
fields.id: Apakah stok, PO, atau PR menutup kebutuhan: Covered by stock, Waiting PO/PR, Late, Short, atau Need item.

fields.label: Hold Until
fields.en: The date a hold ends by itself. Empty when the stock is not on hold.
fields.id: Tanggal Hold berakhir sendiri. Kosong bila stok tidak ditahan.

fields.label: Stock Item
fields.en: The raw material chosen for a Need item line. Typed with at least two letters of the name or code. The choice stays on this booking.
fields.id: Bahan baku yang dipilih untuk baris Need item. Ketik minimal dua huruf nama atau kode. Pilihan tersimpan di booking ini.

fields.label: Reason
fields.en: Why the material must be held. Saved with the hold.
fields.id: Alasan bahan harus ditahan. Disimpan bersama Hold.
